body.x: Mipow(www.playbulb.com), an integrated enterprise which has the capability of R&D, design and production, unveiled "Playbulb Candle" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.PLAYBULB candle is a pseudo candle which can illuminate in a wide range of colors. The intensity of light and color can be controlled by the mobile app, PLAYBULB X, available in both Apple and Google.
